description: Samera Ibrahim Kadum Al-Addal at the University of Kufa publishes code and inputs for simulating freight allocation across existing and planned Iraqi road–rail networks. The August 2026 ZIP archive includes node and edge tables, an asset–path capacity model, analysis code and results from 7,200 factorial runs plus 450 capacity-sensitivity runs. Four infrastructure states are combined with demand, disruption and controller settings. Access is free under CC BY 4.0; OpenStreetMap-derived files retain their separate attribution and licensing requirements. The package can test network-transition and allocation policies in simulation. Current capacities and disruption parameters are transparent assumptions, not calibrated Iraqi operating measurements. It is not an operational digital twin, and real-world predictive accuracy is unknown. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this configured model. The complete Geofabrik extract is omitted, and code was not executed.
